description: Ansible Playbook Security Audit — Offline audit of an Ansible playbook, role or task file (text= or url=, GitHub blob links work): curl-pipe-to-shell, validate_certs off, curl -k, world-writable modes and chmod 777, plain-http downloads, get_url without checksum, hardcoded passwords/tokens/become passwords, secrets without no_log, templated vars in shell without | quote, SSH host-key checking off, sshd root/password login, SELinux or firewall disabled, state: latest, ignore_errors, shell instead of modules, deprecated sudo. Returns verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade and findings with line numbers and fixes. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_ansible_check
